title: Separably closed direct-image bound with an acyclic coefficient forgetful functor
statement: Let k be a separably closed field, Λ a commutative ring, X and Y schemes, f:X→Y a quasi-compact morphism, and a:X→Spec k locally of finite type. Suppose dim X≤d for a natural d. Suppose for every etale V→X and every injective Λ-module sheaf I on V, the underlying abelian sheaf has zero positive cohomology. If M is a Λ-module sheaf on X whose restrictions to every etale V→X have torsion underlying abelian sheaves, then R^q f_* M=0 for every integer q>2d. The notions are [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-direct-image, def-kun-dimension, def-kun-separably-closed].

proof.text: For affine W etale over Y, let V=W×_Y X. The morphism V→X is etale, so dim V≤dim X≤d. Quasi-compactness of f makes V quasi-compact. Its structure map to Spec k is locally of finite type and quasi-compact. The absolute finite-type torsion bound over the separably closed field gives H^q(V,M|V)=0 for q>2d for the underlying abelian sheaf.

The acyclicity assumption and exact etale restriction identify this vanishing with Ext from the free Λ-sheaf represented by V. The higher-image presheaf on every affine etale W is therefore zero. Affine etale objects are cover-dense; sheafification of that presheaf is R^q f_*M and is zero. This is the proved source argument, including the Ext comparison and local-surjectivity check.
